item.title: About
item.description:
Hi there!

Like many, I have lofty dreams and grand ambitions. I love the idea of what software could do, and enjoy solving problems, tweaking systems, and learning new things.

What is important, is not only what you do, but how you do it.

What you’ll find

Content includes:

  • ramblings,
  • previous thoughts (and mistakes),
  • processes
  • #TIL (today I learned) moments,
  • hobbies and achievements,
  • tooling & setup,
  • niche problems,
  • some philosophy,

Open source

Has provided me with experience and tools I use even now. I believe in contributing and giving back to the open-source community.
